What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[Rey]]: left, the image of [[Rey (Errata)]] (holotable commit e8445f0); right, the image of [[Rey (Errata 2)]] (holotable commit 9d2c01e). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/rey.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/rey.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
